✨What will you find at the EMO Exhibition?✨



 Metrios optical Z-Axis, the new feature for height measurement. 

Thanks to the auto-focus technology, you can acquire measures at different height level: in this way, you can measure the height of a surface without touching the part.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
The Z-measurement makes it possible to reduce or completely eliminate the repositioning and clamping phase and allows the operator to check areas that would otherwise not be visible. 

Come to the exhibition and discover the measurement in 3 dimensions!

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue

Metrios Re-Light , the optical measuring machine with a rotary axis, designed for both flat and cylindrical parts.

​​​​​Measure all surfaces at once with a single device and relieve the operator from the continuous repositioning of the component.

Metrios automatically finds the reference point to orientate your measurement: place the part and let Metrios Re-light do the rest!
